definitions.gloss: dark gray; charcoal gray; deep gray
definitions.explanation: A dark shade of gray approaching black. Used to describe colors in fashion, materials, and natural phenomena. Formed with the prefix 濃 (dark, deep, concentrated) added to 灰色 (gray).

examples.japanese: {濃灰色|のうはいいろ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦スーツ→スーツ：01367_suutsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{似合|にあ}う→似合う：02134_niau⟧。
examples.english: A dark gray suit looks good on you.

examples.japanese: ⟦{雨雲|あまぐも}→雨雲：22808_amagumo⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{濃灰色|のうはいいろ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{空|そら}→空：02216_sora⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{覆|おお}っている→覆う：02020_oou⟧。
examples.english: Rain clouds are covering the sky in dark gray.

examples.japanese: ⟦{車|くるま}→車：00516_kuruma⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{色|いろ}→色：00849_iro⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{濃灰色|のうはいいろ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{選|えら}んだ→選ぶ：00835_erabu⟧。⟦{汚|よご}れ→汚れ：03186_yogore⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{目立|めだ}ち→目立つ：02431_medatsu⟧にくい⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧だ。
examples.english: I chose dark gray for the car color because it doesn't show dirt easily.

notes:
Composed of {濃|のう} (dark, deep, concentrated) and ⟦{灰色|はいいろ}→灰色：04303_haiiro⟧ (gray). Often used in fashion and design contexts. In everyday speech, ⟦{濃|こ}い→濃い：02344_koi⟧⟦{灰色|はいいろ}→灰色：04303_haiiro⟧ (using the i-adjective form) is more common, while {濃灰色|のうはいいろ} appears more in written descriptions, product catalogs, and formal color designations.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {濃灰色|のうはいいろ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{背景|はいけい}→背景：28348_haikei⟧: dark gray background
- {濃灰色|のうはいいろ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{石|いし}→石：02177_ishi⟧: dark gray stone
- {濃灰色|のうはいいろ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦コート→コート：01358_kooto⟧: dark gray coat

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {薄灰色|うすはいいろ}: light gray — the lighter counterpart
- チャコール⟦グレー→グレー：24406_guree⟧: charcoal gray — the English loanword, commonly used in fashion
- {鼠色|ねずみいろ}: mouse gray — a traditional Japanese color name for medium gray
